summary: 🍅on last minute graduate applications. Hopefully incoming class all set for next semester.....Have to catch up on advising emails but keeping head down until grants, books, and classes done. Need the grant done tonight so I can split next week between instructional design and book writing.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: 🍅on last minute graduate applications. Hopefully incoming class all set for next semester.....Have to catch up on advising emails but keeping head down until grants, books, and classes done. Need the grant done tonight so I can split next week between instructional design and book writing.
